Name: Ilucie's Location Tracker
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
This mod displays your current tile position (X and Y) and the name of the map you're on in the top left corner of the screen.

These coordinates, for example, can be used to quickly add or modify warp points in CJBCheatsMenu or similar mods.



The display can be toggled on and off by pressing F2. You can change the toggle key via the config.json in the mod files.

You can move the position of the ingame overlay via the config.json as well. Just change the "DisplayPosition" to one of the following:
TopLeft, TopRight, BottomLeft, BottomRight
